verdict.structural_ceiling_note: 100% useful MFU is impossible for this 2,048-token gate/up shape at measured traffic; the same-traffic HBM roof is about 34.14%.
verdict.recoverable_gap_note: 22.66% family MFU is not a hard floor: the representative gate/up launch is 10.89 percentage points below its same-traffic HBM roof, with only 68.12% DRAM throughput and 35.84% issue active.

audit.evidence: HTTP 200; 16,384 prompt; one output; cached_tokens=0; matching input/output hashes
immutable Nsys SQLite; request epoch mapped to session time; exact demangled-name aggregation
80 + 80 launches, anchored by activation and shuffle/combine neighbors; exact family reconciliation
70 sparse launches; BF16 HGMMA SASS; first dense chunk retained as a separate exact name
q_b and o_proj identified independently; 31 same-name launches retain time but contribute no numerator
NCU 2.016544 ms versus Nsys gate/up mean 2.005954 ms (+0.53%)
884-second request includes 33-pass kernel replay; only per-launch counters are used
